rows.text: After reopening at 14:51 on 18 February 2026, the House of Councillors' first ballot gave no majority: of 246 votes (majority 124), 高市早苗 123, 小川淳也 58, 玉木雄一郎 25, 神谷宗幣 15, 田村智子 7, 奥田ふみよ 5, 水岡俊一 5, 伊波洋一 2, 百田尚樹 2, 福島みずほ 2, 安野貴博 1 and 1 blank; a runoff between 高市早苗 and 小川淳也 followed under House rule 20(3).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the runoff on 18 February 2026 the House of Councillors designated 高市早苗: of 246 votes, 高市早苗 125 and 小川淳也 65, with 48 invalid and 8 blank. The sitting adjourned at 15:50.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12).
